subject: Setting default browser size when a shiny app is run

messages.author: c051402ecb8495d2
messages.subject: Setting default browser size when a shiny app is run
parts: I have developed a shiny app that contains multiple tabs. the width of the client area is about 1160px. When I launch the application, the browser width is always around 960px and a height of about 800px. Is there a way to initialize Shiny browser/frame window to a specific size?
